summary: Radiopharm Theranostics filed a Form 6-K with an attached ASX announcement dated August 17, 2026, reporting that it scheduled an End-of-Phase 2 meeting with the U.S. FDA for October 1, 2026, to align on the pivotal Phase 3 trial design for RAD101, an imaging agent for suspected recurrent brain metastases. The Phase 2b trial met its primary endpoint with 93% concordance with MRI. The company plans to be Phase 3-ready by year-end 2026. This is a routine regulatory milestone announcement, not a special situation. No deal terms, M&A activity, or strategic corporate events are involved.
